# panos_administrator (Resource)



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (Attributes) The location of this object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `authentication_profile` (String) Authentication profile for this administrator
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable this administrator account
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Hashed administrator password
- `public_key` (String) SSH public key for certificate-based authentication
- `role` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An administrator can be imported by providing the following base64 encoded object as the ID
# {
#   location = {
#     panorama = {}
#   }
#
#   name = "example-admin"
# }
terraform import panos_administrator.example $(echo '{"location":{"panorama":{}},"name":"example-admin"}' | base64)
```
